name: Karst
description: Limestone pavement: solid clints with the grikes weathered clean through between them.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @pick(polygon(0 0, 88% 0, 100% 88%, 12% 100%), polygon(10% 0, 100% 6%, 92% 100%, 0 90%), polygon(0 8%, 90% 0, 100% 92%, 8% 100%)); clip-path: @pick(polygon(0 0, 88% 0, 100% 88%, 12% 100%), polygon(10% 0, 100% 6%, 92% 100%, 0 90%), polygon(0 8%, 90% 0, 100% 92%, 8% 100%)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
